## Security verdict: PASS WITH NOTES

PR #177, exact head `ff13b5ad6629cb63ceb3f5a8264c1442018b6cc7`.

Reviewed `b425d07..ff13b5a` and directly coupled ingress/render paths. F002 is source-repaired. **The legacy human line is still raw and is not rendered through #182's grammar.** No high-confidence new exploitable delta was identified; prior raw-display and project-path notes stand.

| # | Severity | File | Lines | Vulnerability | Confidence |
|---|----------|------|-------|---------------|------------|
| - | - | - | - | No new exploitable vulnerability identified | - |

### Recovery gate

The changed filter omits prime recovery recommendations only while the designation is live, without hiding waiting counts (`crates/daemon/src/community/directory.rs:488`). Live means an untombstoned registry entry, not fresh process proof (`crates/daemon/src/http/directory.rs:587`).

The regression pair checks live designation plus queued request gives no prime action; a tombstoned designation gives exactly the project-set action (`crates/daemon/tests/directory_http.rs:7417`). This changes advisory output, not assignments, designation, queue delivery or authorization. Legacy rows remain excluded from live/activity/call-on decisions (`directory.rs:413`).

### Grammar is not applied to the legacy sink

The projection copies stored seat, instance and start-time strings (`directory.rs:431`). The CLI prints seat and repair command without `SeatId::rendered()` (`crates/cli/src/main.rs:3301`); invalid timestamps still fall back to the original string (`:3191`).

Historical/rebuilt rows are not retroactively grammar-checked (`crates/daemon/src/community/holders.rs:301`; `directory.rs:747`). Instances are not seat IDs: their ingress validator still rejects extra slash and surrounding whitespace, not all presentation controls (`crates/daemon/src/http/directory.rs:1433`).

#182 checks newly minted seat IDs during registration/spawn (`crates/daemon/src/registration.rs:825`; `crates/daemon/src/http/mod.rs:1364`). Its separate PA-digest render-time guards cover historical values there (`crates/core/src/pa_digest.rs:137`), not this terminal legacy line.

All repair-command arguments are shell-word quoted (`crates/daemon/src/community/picture.rs:98`). That prevents shell breakout but does not neutralize terminal escapes or embedded newlines. No newly introduced automatic command execution or model-injection path was established in this delta. This verdict does not clear the separate held-head S184-001 memory-prompt finding.

### Proof

No C19/C21 disclosure was identified in scoped additions. GitHub metadata and the independent remote pull ref agree on the full reviewed SHA; GitHub reports CLEAN. CI run `42457966410` and Delivers run `42457966381` both identify this SHA and success.

No local tests, builds, runtime views/role operations, credential reads, probes or mutations were performed.
